title: I'm a Celebrity returns to ITV on Monday
summary: Ant and Dec are back in the Australian jungle with 11 campmates, including Wayne Rooney.
body:
The new series of I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! starts on Monday 16 November at 9 p.m. on ITV1 and ITVX.

Ant and Dec return to present the show live from the Australian jungle.

Who is going in

ITV has confirmed 11 campmates:

  • Wayne Rooney, former England footballer
  • AJ Odudu, television presenter
  • Joanna Page, Gavin & Stacey actress
  • Claire Sweeney, actress
  • Ade Adepitan, Paralympian and presenter
  • Chloe Burrows, Love Island star
  • Jack Skipper, comedian
  • Leomie Anderson, model
  • Mariella Frostrup, broadcaster
  • Ricky Wilson, Kaiser Chiefs singer
  • Sharky, social media star

Adepitan will be the first wheelchair user to take part, and producers are adapting the camp for him.

Correction, 14 November: an earlier version of this story said ITV had not yet announced the line-up. ITV confirmed it on 10 November.

Sources: ITV, HuffPost UK, TV Guide.
